sources.text: For 25 years, XBOX has remained focused on building games players love, and our anniversary year has been a particularly strong example. From Gears of War: E-Day , Forza Horizon 6 , and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , to hugely anticipated games like Fable , players have more great games to play on XBOX than ever. Today, The Game Awards has announced this year’s list of nominees and titles across XBOX’s creative teams have earned eight nominations across multiple categories. Outside of gaming, Prime Video’s ‘Fallout’ has been nominated for Best Adaptation. Thank you to all of the teams that brought these great games to players. Voting is now open on The Game Awards’ official site – tune into The Game Awards on December 10 to see if your favorite games from 2026 take home an award. Our publishing partners also received nominations across a range of categories, with many games available to play today with Game Pass. 007 First Light and CONTROL Resonant are both nominated for Game of the Year and playable across devices with XBOX Play Anywhere. Game Pass subscribers can play nominees like Gears of War: E-Day , Forza Horizon 6 , No Man’s Sky , and more. See below for the full list of nominees playable on XBOX, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and remember you can vote for your favorites right now over at TheGameAwards.com . In the meantime, many of these titles will be available at their lowest prices yet with XBOX’s Black Friday sale, starting November 19 – find out more here . Congratulations to this year’s incredible nominees!

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
sources.text: The latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 Thursday, November 19, available at PlayStation Store. The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet. Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he’d like it to turn out but right now, it’s hard to tell. Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk, and life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out but now more than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands. Leonida is made up of six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga. Here’s a closer look at what makes each region unique. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world. We’re a long way from the ’80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America Life in this tropical archipelago isn’t flashy but it’s easy. Get your buzz on and pull up a deck chair but look out — you are right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America. You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse. The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves. Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won’t bring the tourists back, but there’s a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It’s fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme — whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, while the local biker gang provides almost everything else. A national landmark up against the state’s northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government. Spanning stations including Classic Rock, Modern Hip-Hop, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latin, ‘80s, Electronic, Blues, Ballads, Talk Radio, and much more, Grand Theft Auto VI features the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet. Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones.

sources.text: O mais novo título da série Grand Theft Auto nos leva ao estado de Leonida, até as ruas iluminadas de neon de Vice City e além. Jason e Lucia sempre souberam que as cartas não estavam a favor deles. Mas quando o que deveria ser um trabalho fácil dá errado, eles se encontram no lado mais escuro do lugar mais ensolarado da América, no meio de uma conspiração criminosa que cobre todo o estado de Leonida, forçados a depender um do outro mais do que nunca se quiserem sair vivos. Grand Theft Auto VI chega para PlayStation 5 quinta-feira, 19 de novembro, disponível na PlayStation Store. O jogo se passa no estado de Leonida, onde ficam as ruas banhadas de neon de Vice City e além, na maior e mais imersiva evolução da série até hoje. Jason cresceu rodeado de bandidos e vigaristas. Após um período no exército para tentar se livrar de sua adolescência perturbada, ele se encontra nos Keys fazendo o que faz melhor, trabalhando para traficantes de drogas locais. Conhecer Lucia pode ser a melhor ou a pior coisa que já aconteceu com ele. Jason sabe como gostaria que tudo terminasse, mas agora, é difícil prever. O pai de Lucia a ensinou a lutar desde que ela aprendeu a andar, e a vida tem vindo com tudo para cima dela desde então. Lutar por sua família a colocou na Penitenciária de Leonida. Sorte pura a livrou desta vez, mas agora mais do que qualquer coisa, Lucia deseja a vida boa com a qual sua mãe sonhava desde que moravam em Liberty City. Em vez de fantasias pela metade, Lucia está preparada para assumir o controle da situação. Leonida é composto de seis regiões: Vice City, as Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, e Mount Kalaga. Vamos conhecer o que torna cada região única. O glamour, o trabalho e a ganância da América capturados em uma única cidade. Cada bairro tem algo a oferecer, dos hóteis de art deco, cores pastel e areia branca de Ocean Beach, até as padarias de Little Cuba e as marcas falsificadas do mercadinho de Tisha-Wocka, até o VC Port, a capital mundial dos navios de cruzeiro. Estamos longe dos anos 80, mas Vice City ainda é a capital do sol e da diversão da América. A vida neste arquipélago tropical não é chamativa, mas é boa. Pegue uma cervejinha e puxe uma cadeira de praia, mas tome cuidado, você está à beira das águas mais belas e perigosas da América. Você nunca sabe o que está sob a superfície desta região primordial. Os jacarés podem ser a atração mais famosa, mas há predadores bem mais perigosos e descobertas mais estranhas entre o manguezal. Motéis baratos, atrações fechadas, e galerias de lojas vazias e abandonadas não vão trazer os turistas de volta, mas há uma nova economia neste local que já foi um ponto turístico. Agora mandam o as bebidas baratas, remédios contra a dor e bebidas energéticas. No coração de Leonida, a indústria Americana e os antigos valores ainda reinam supremos, seja qual for o custo. A refinaria de açúcar Allied Crystal providencia os empregos, e a gangue de motociclistas local providencia quase todo o resto. Um marco nacional na fronteira norte do estado, Mount Kalaga oferece as melhores trilhas off-road e pontos de pesca e caça. Nas florestas em torno, caipiras místicos e radicais paranóicos vivem longe dos olhos vigilantes do governo. Com estações de Rock Clássico, Hip-Hop Moderno, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latina, Anos 80, Electrônica, Blues, Baladas, Talk Radio, e muito mais, Grand Theft Auto VI possui a maior e mais variada seleção de rádios em um jogo até hoje. Além disso, pela primeira vez, Grand Theft Auto VI apresenta uma série de podcasts sob demanda para Jason e Lucia ouvirem além das rádios de Leonida, com ambos disponíveis para ouvir em veículos e a pé usando fones de ouvido e earbuds conectados aos seus smartphones.

sources.title: 99 Incredible Little Details in Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is here, and we’re finally getting to see what Rockstar has been cooking up for the last decade-and-change. It may be a studio already famous for its unbridled attention to detail, but just how many more tiny flourishes, references, and opportunities for emergent hilarity has Rockstar stuffed into GTA 6? The answer is a lot, so let’s get straight to it: here are 99 incredible little details in Grand Theft Auto 6. And don’t worry, you’ll find no story spoilers here. 1. From the get-go, it appears Rockstar has left no box unchecked. That is, during the Prologue, there’s a strong chance you’ll be successfully captured by the VCPD before you can effect a getaway. However, if you do manage to escape, you’ll get an extra segment of gameplay after the prison counselor addresses your initial evasion, in which she may even name-check the vehicle you used. 2. GTA 6’s selection of radio stations and podcasts is fabulous, and massively stocked with songs. Want to hear them when you’re outside of a car? You can purchase earbuds at an electronics store so that you can tune in via your phone. 3. Blood stains remain in the world for multiple days, so you may well receive a reminder of some poor behaviour on your part, even after sleeping and returning to the same spot in the days that follow. 4. Gang hideouts will reveal themselves all over the map as you progress, but one of the first you’ll probably find is an illegal animal smuggling operation tucked away in Jason’s hometown. Make sure you listen to the parrot for a clue to find more loot. 5. Speaking of animals, keep in mind that dogs will protect their owners, so consider that before you insult anyone out walking their best friend. 6. It’s also common to come across animals fighting amongst themselves, but if you spook them, they’ll typically scarper. 7. And no, it doesn’t appear that crocodiles take much interest in unconscious people that you may dump near them. But when they wake up, all bets are off. 8. The highly impressive blood tech will realistically coat surfaces the claret touches, such as covering a croc’s snout after snacking on an unfortunate fellow’s head. 9. Don’t park your car too close to the basketball hoop outside Jason’s first house. Even a well-placed shot could smash the windows of your ride. 10. Of course, cars can suffer considerably more than a busted windscreen, and car damage in GTA 6 is ludicrously good. Panels buckle dramatically, parts fall off, and dents appear exactly where they should. 11. Lose a wheel and the unfortunate rotor scraping against the asphalt will glow bright red as it dramatically heats up. 12. There’s a distinct difference in paint quality between hasty Pay ’n’ Spray jobs and professional recoats at a dedicated auto shop. Pay ’n’ Sprays offer extremely limited colours, and the paint finish has a noticeable “orange peel” effect. 13. Car glass isn’t perfect and, in the right light, you can see lots of scuffs, scratches, and imperfections. 14. Wipers will even leave visible streaks on the glass during rain, even though that’s something you’d only ever see rarely in the first-person view. 15. Businesses have their own vehicles, and you’ll spot vans and trucks across the map with all kinds of corporate and small business logos plastered on them. We’re still seeing ones we haven’t noticed, even after 120 hours, and it greatly increases the feeling of vehicle variety on the road. 16. The details on cars even extend to the fact that they have animated drivetrains – you can more easily spot when you flip a car, so take this as an excuse to get a little chaotic. 17. Some cars even have under-door lighting – an incredibly subtle effect you may well only occasionally see at night. 18. Brakes glow as a result of heavy use. 19. Superchargers make a very distinct noise, and your engine will sound different once you install them. 20. Vehicles have functioning indicators and windows, and you may even spot NPCs rolling up their windows if you’re annoying them. To use your own blinkers, tap left and right on the D-pad. 21. Truck nuts on vehicles. That’s it. No, they don’t shrink in the cold, but I’m not holding that against it. 22. Alongside the massive number of regular vehicles to discover, there are many unique vehicles sporting huge, custom decorations to find. One is a bright pink fan for a seafood restaurant that has “Our Shrimp so Pimp” painted on it. 23. There are also much, much cooler examples, including a very, very familiar Fast and Furious-adjacent green sports car with a custom paint job, tucked away in the largest house on Vespucci Island. The plate is the perfect touch, too: HAD YOU. 24. Like the cars, boats have also been lavished with attention to detail, and are typically christened with their own individual names, just like in real life. 25. And on that note, boats can now be physically launched from boat trailers, retrieved from the water again, and towed to anywhere else on the map. Same goes for jet skis and kayaks. 26. Cars and motorcycles can also be manually loaded onto trailers and towed anywhere you want. It doesn’t get around the tracker system, so it isn’t a method to cheat the new security features, but it’s still fun to fool around with. 27. Not only are jumbo jets way, way more authentically scaled – seriously, they’re huge now – but you need to enter them physically and walk to the cockpit to fly them. 28. Hijacking an enormous commercial airliner isn’t a thing the authorities will ignore or quickly forget. Soon after takeoff, you’ll be flanked by a pair of fighter jets who’ll order you to land, and shoot you down if you don’t. Jumbos are tougher than ever and will survive direct strikes from smaller aircraft, like choppers, but maybe it’s best to follow their orders. 29. sources.text: Actors revealed! Viewership records broken! Lots of honorary New Zealanders! The day is finally here: Grand Theft Auto 6 is available to play worldwide. It's destined to become the largest video game release of all time, and probably one of the biggest entertainment releases of all time. So we're doing a launch day live blog to chart its arrival in the world. Have you played it yet? I'm curious how many people stayed up until midnight in their region to give the game a go. I couldn't manage it but my college-age son was contemplating it. And if you have played it, what do you think - what are your early impressions? Is this what you were waiting for? More broadly, I wonder about the impact GTA 6 will have on the wider world. I've already seen nearly all mainstream news and media outlets attempt to cover the game - and many other kinds of businesses - so will GTA 6 make people reappraise video games? Moreover, exactly how big will the launch be? The record books are ready to be written in, but what exactly will be written? And how will other games fare in GTA's wake - better, or worse? There's lots to consider as the ripples spread around the world. We'll pull-in stories and developments, and your comments, as we chart the arrival of Rockstar's game around the world. Let's get to it. Our live coverage of this event has finished. An historic day in gaming and there's loads to unpack. But to begin with, this: did you take a day off to play GTA 6, and have you played it yet? Rockstar's marketing department has gone all out The marketing push by Rockstar to have GTA 6 imprint on real-world cities has been impressive to see. There have been festivals in Miami, Selfridges dedicated a portion of its department store to selling GTA merch, but there's more than this besides. The London Standard summarised much of the activity in London in a video on Instagram. A post shared by The Standard (@thelondonstandard) Rockstar employment tribunal verdict could take weeks The din of release is in danger of drowning out the Rockstar employment tribunal that came to a close this week in Scotland. Former Eurogamer video producer Chris Bratt - now co-owner of People Make Games - has been following the case closely, and reported yesterday that a verdict in the case could take "weeks". He quotes Judge Lucy Wiseman as saying: "I cannot give a time frame for producing the judgement in this case. What I will say is that I will use my best endeavors to get that judgement out as quickly as I possibly can." And that's it for the Rockstar tribunal! We await the judge's decision, but how long will it take? Judge Lucy Wiseman: "I cannot give a time frame for producing the judgement in this case. What I will say is that I will use my best endeavors to get that judgement out as quickly as I possibly can." Yesterday, we independently confirmed that most, if not all, of the fired Rockstar employees are credited in the GTA 6 credits - which are, according to Chris Tapsell, our reviewer, an enormous thing in their own right. Yesterday, my mother _(whose single dabble in gaming over the years can be described as,“working out the way to bypass the Brontosaurus Guarding Causeway in the text adventure Time Machine, is to GIVE it the Ship’s Biscuit found aboard the Marie Celeste”)_ texted me to ask if I was “ready for tomorrow?” I instantly assumed I’d made or hinted at some plan to do something with her and subsequently forgotten. BUT, NO. She was asking if I was ready for GTA. A product I have never mentioned in her presence in all my many years. So if you’ve got the over-seventies non-gamers talking… I’d say you’ve cracked it. Goodness! And will your mother also be playing it? My inbox is flooded with all kinds of brands trying to get in on the GTA 6 hype. The most recent one? Petrol prices. "Having to refuel your car in GTA 6 adds another layer of realism to the game, but it's something real-life drivers have to think about every time they get behind the wheel," said Beth Fountain, fuel expert at somewhere called Interfuels. "With petrol and diesel prices remaining high, filling up can take a significant chunk out of someone's monthly budget, particularly for those who rely on their vehicles for work or regular travel. "While players might find the new mechanic frustrating, it's a reminder of how much we depend on fuel in everyday life and how quickly those costs can add up." There's another one from Just Eat, the food delivery company, which has apparently made a real controller with Just Eat order button on it for you to order food while gaming. It's not specifically GTA 6-linked but it's jumping on that bandwagon. The controller is apparently synced to your Just Eat account. Imagine mashing that by accident and having an accidental feast turn up. "When you're deep into a high-stakes gaming session nothing kills the moment faster than having to pause the action just to sort out food. With the Just ChEAT Button, Just Eat has unlocked the ultimate hack to evade the kitchen, enabling gamers to stay just where they are and locked into play," said Just East UK and Ireland marketing director Tina Koehler. It's not clear where you can buy this controller or how much it costs. It's described as "limited edition". I wonder if that means only one has been made. The goofy things people are already doing in GTA 6 Many people are playing GTA 6 already of course and doing expectedly bizarre things in it. From lobbing hammers like Crocodile Dundee lobs cans of tinned food, to dropkicking people, to attempting to dive through a car window while oiled up and in one's pants - Connor has rounded up some of the goofiest clips around. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI understands just how important a smartphone is
sources.text: Text messages, social networking, selfies — the device is integrated into every aspect of your virtual life. Text messages, social networking, selfies — the device is integrated into every aspect of your virtual life. Grand Theft Auto VI , in many ways, tries to simulate real life. And life in 2026 would not be complete without a smartphone. GTA VI understands this and makes the phone not just a central part of the experience, but an object that exists within the world. You may try to escape into a fantasy of robbing banks and fighting drug lords, but you can’t get away from texts from your mom or nagging fitness app notifications. Seeing a smartphone in a game isn’t a new phenomenon. The device has become a natural stand-in for the main menu in many games, giving players an interface that feels intuitive, because a phone is something they use every day. But the phone in GTA VI is different for a few reasons. One is that it behaves much like any other object in the game, whether it’s a gun or a bottle of beer. The action doesn’t pause when you use your phone. Instead, the game switches to a first-person viewpoint, where you can still walk around — or drive, if you’re feeling ambitious — while reading texts or flipping through a fictional version of Instagram. Rob Nelson, the co-studio head at developer Rockstar North and producer on GTA VI , says that it would’ve felt “archaic” to have a static phone that worked like those in other games, or the one in GTA V , which appeared as a pop-up at the bottom of the screen across from the minimap. “We felt that it was important to make it physical so you have to look at it and put your attention on it, including while driving,” he explains. “It’s about finding the line between realism and player convenience. But the act of being lost in your phone felt like something worth doing, even though it could mean slightly more inconvenience. In this game you are committing to using it.” (Of course, texting and driving, like much of what you do in GTA VI , is both very dangerous and very illegal.) You have to interact with the phone in the game constantly. Often the story plays out through phone calls and text messages, and you have a surprisingly large array of apps to use that serve a real purpose in the game. You manage your money in a banking app, use a rideshare app when you need a lift, track your workouts in a fitness app, scroll through a social network complete with comments and the ability to like posts, and sideload an AI tool that scans nearby cars so you can see how easy they’ll be to steal. You can even change the wallpaper and ringtone. ( GTA VI has two main characters that you swap between, and each has their own phone, though they’re functionally identical.) What’s most impressive is how all of these apps interact with each other. For instance, after pulling off a major heist, a friend might text you a news story about it, asking “was this you!?” You can then click the link, open up the news app, and read an actual article about what went down. These kinds of interactions can be functional, like when another character texts you a location, which you can then add to your map so the GPS can guide you there. Other times, they add texture to the world or depth to the characters. GTA VI is a love story about two criminals named Jason and Lucia, and you play as both. At one point, while controlling Lucia, I got a text asking for a selfie. I opened up the camera, shot a pic of Lucia drinking a latte, and sent it over. Jason replied immediately — and their relationship got a boost. Phones are so fully integrated into the game that they can even interrupt the characters’ sleep. At the end of each day, you can click on a bed to rest for the night. But neither Jason nor Lucia will instantly fall asleep when you do — instead, they’ll sit down and pull out their phone, and you have the option to doomscroll or catch up on texts instead of going to sleep right away. Nelson says that this was implemented because the developers wanted to include the ability for the characters to sit on the bed at night, much like a real couple in a shared living space might do. “We needed something to do aside from just sitting there staring at nothing,” he says. If nothing else, GTA VI ’s phone shows how alike we all are: Even bank robbers being hunted by the police can’t seem to stop scrolling. “Phones are a constant part of our lives,” Nelson says of the evolution, “even more than they were in 2013.”

sources.text: How to access a surprisingly playable glitched first-person mode in Grand Theft Auto 6 You can play Grand Theft Auto 6 in first-person mode. Rockstar might not want you to, but you can. Itâs thanks to a new glitch that has been recently discovered, and itâs surprisingly simple to activate. Better yet, this glitched first-person view seems to be more fully fleshed out than you might expect, even allowing Jason and Lucia to naturally wield weapons, FPS-style. If youâre a fan of the first-person perspectives of past GTA and Red Dead Redemption games, youâll want to try this out. Weâre breaking down everything you need to know to activate and use the glitched first-person mode in Grand Theft Auto 6 . The first-person glitch is a very simple camera glitch. As you probably already know, the game will activate a first-person perspective when youâre looking at your phone, covering half of the screen. This is a very natural way to convey that driving and texting is dangerous and illegal, but itâs GTA. To perform this glitch, we first shortcut the Camera adjustment button to an easily pressed button on the controller â this will be the Touch Pad on PS5 , and the Back button on Xbox . After thatâs in place, we sit in a car, look at our phone, and as we back out of looking at the phone, we mash the Camera button shortcut quickly. Hitting the camera button within the first frame or two of putting away the phone will keep the first-person view, without the phone in the way. Again, this will actually allow Jason and Lucia to perform almost everything from a first-person perspective. This includes driving, shooting, grabbing items, and much more. The only problem is that this view can be disabled when using a menu that changes the cameraâs perspective, like buying something from a shop menu at Ammu-Nation or a garage. sources.text: The Grand Theft Auto series has a propensity for memorable protagonists. Tommy Vercetti in Vice City, CJ in San Andreas, and Niko Bellic in 4 are key to what makes their respective entries so beloved. The same is true for Michael, Franklin, and Trevor regarding 5, and it should come as no surprise that GTA 6 pays an all-too-appropriate nod to the trio who led the previous entry in the series. While driving around Leonida and enjoying the podcast Vice City True Stories, you'll eventually start hearing about a few familiar names. It's a true crime podcast, because of course it is, and one of the subjects is a certain bank heist you'll know plenty about if you've completed the main story of Grand Theft Auto 5. Specifically, Trevor's pal Wade Hebert, and the suspicious deaths of Floyd and Deborah. The hosts are skeptical of his connection to Trevor, and how protective he was of Trevor's two partners in crime. A whole segment's been clipped on Twitter by DiscussingFilm if you can't play just now. "Could it be that the photograph was actually of three dangerous criminals? Criminals who knew how to handle a knife or a gun?" the host ponders. "Taking out Floyd and Deborah might have been as easy for them as it is for me to take no notice of failed auditions or final demands for payment." Oh, you don't know the half of it. These three men made Los Santos their playground, and they did it over and over again for years - though for you it would've been a much shorter period of time. "There were so many more questions about Michael, Franklin, and Wade's BFF," she continues. "What did Wade mean about robbing all them banks?" What did he mean, indeed. It's a delightfully meta way to tie the two games together, setting things up for further elaboration whenever Rockstar wants to go deeper. Since the game has podcasts, I hope the intention is to continue recording episodes and keep the radio selection updated. sources.text: This would easily give it the highest day one sales in entertainment history Estimates suggest that Grand Theft Auto 6 has enjoyed the most successful launch in entertainment history. Sensor Tower , which tracks video game sales figures including estimated pre-orders, copies sold and revenue worldwide, estimates that the game had sold 24.58 million copies by the end of its first day. This amounts to a total revenue of around $2.36 billion, easily making back the game’s budget â which was speculated to be anything between $1-2 billion â on day one. Sensor Tower’s data suggests that around 75% of the game’s sales were on PlayStation 5 versus Xbox Series X/S , meaning roughly 18.4 million copies were sold on Sony ‘s console and around 6.15 million on Xbox . Neither Rockstar nor its parent company Take-Two have officially confirmed day one sales for the game yet, meaning Sensor Tower’s estimate is the closest thing we have to a solid number so far. Should the figures be accurate, this would not only easily make GTA 6 the fastest-selling video game in history, but also the most successful piece of entertainment in history in terms of global box office. The numbers would certainly eclipse those of the game’s predecessor, Grand Theft Auto 5 , which sold around 11.21 million copies in its first day and generated more than $815 million in worldwide revenue. This then reached $1 billion within the first three days, which at the time was considered the fastest that any entertainment property had reached that milestone. Since then, a billion-dollar weekend has happened in the world of cinema, with Avengers : Endgame said to have the biggest worldwide opening of all time with $1.22 billion in its opening weekend. As such, should Sensor Tower’s estimate for GTA 6 be even remotely close, it will still suggest a day one revenue that has easily overtaken that of Marvel’s movie. sources.text: GTA 6 may not have launched with the option to play it entirely in first-person, but where there’s a will, there’s a way. Players have already worked out how to switch from the default third-person perspective, and it requires quite a few fiddly button presses. While you can’t play through the whole of GTA 6 from behind Jason and Lucia’s eyes, there are certain moments where that is a valid option. These include clicking in the right analog stick while holding the left trigger with a weapon unequipped to enter “inspect mode,” which lets you get a closer look at things when standing still. Another instance is when pulling up your phone while driving, which puts you behind the wheel, making steering a bit harder while checking your texts. But now the GTA 6 community has unlocked a way to switch into genuine first-person, allowing you to roam Leonida, fire your guns, and rob stores from much closer to the action. Here’s how to do it, although we can’t guarantee how long this method will last before Rockstar issues a patch fixing it. Note: this appears to currently be working on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. It might take a few tries, but once done, you’ll now be locked into first-person for the rest of your session. Dying won’t reset it, but reloading your save or quitting the game will. Just like the method, the results are by no means perfect, though. It’s a little buggy, with some jank to be found with aiming a weapon, or certain animations not quite agreeing with this glitched version of first-person. It does, however, give us a glimpse of what the future may look like for GTA 6. After all, GTA 5 didn’t receive an official first-person perspective option until it was released on PS4 and Xbox One in 2014, a year after its first launch. And, of course players are already using this forced first-person perspective to try to see Jason and Lucia naked in the shower . Under normal circumstances, can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6? sources.title: How to change time in GTA 6
sources.text: Being able to change time in Grand Theft Auto 6 is quite helpful, as you can only start some missions at a certain time of day. Progressing through the campaign is not the only reason to do so. Some businesses are open only for a period of the day, like the bank, for example. To help you plan your day, we've put this guide together explaining how to change time in GTA 6, as well as how long a day lasts . In GTA 6 , if you want to change time, the best option is to simply go to bed . At Jason's house , when you approach the bed, you can interact with it and choose the "Sleep" option. Ironically, this won't make the characters fall asleep immediately. After lying down on the bed, you can either choose to check your phone, sleep and get up . Select the "Sleep" option , and you will be able to decide when the character is waking up by setting an alarm . You can set a specific time, or you can select one of the following options: morning, night, evening, or noon. For reference, when you wake up in the morning, it means you will start a new day at around 7 a.m. If you're too far from Jason's house to sleep, your next best option is to simply keep playing . Time passes naturally in GTA 6 . By simply exploring the map and visiting locations, the time of the day will eventually change. In-game days might seem like they pass too quickly as you play through the campaign, but, in general, 24 in-game hours take approximately 2 hours and 24 minutes in real life . This duration only applies outside missions, like when you're freely exploring the game and doing side activities. Whenever you start a mission, time follows the script. For example, I headed to the Rusty Anchor bar to begin the "Day Release" mission at 8 a.m., but since this mission's story takes place later in the day, the clock jumped to 3 p.m. when the mission actually started. Although there's no official information on how long an in-game day lasts, we ran some tests to verify that. If you check the time by looking at your phone, pressing down on the D-pad, or even looking at the clock on the wall of Jason's kitchen, you can time the duration of a minute and discover that one in-game minute is equivalent to around six seconds in real life . Multiplying six seconds by the number of minutes in 24 hours (1,440 minutes) gives us 8,640 seconds. Divide this value by 60 to find out minutes, and you'll get the final result. How time passes varies depending on the context too, which can affect the overall duration of an in-game day. When in bed in Jason's house and checking the phone, time won't pass. The same happens in certain segments of missions. If you're just getting started in GTA 6 , we have plenty of guides to help you live the high life in Leonida. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. After years of trailers, delays, rumours, and more leaks than Rockstar Games would probably care to count , we can finally get our hands on one of the most anticipated games of all time. GTA 6 is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S , having officially launched on November 19, 2026. And while plenty of players will already have their consoles hooked up and ready to go, there are still some pretty important questions worth asking: which console actually offers the best way to play GTA 6? Is it worth upgrading to a PS5 Pro? And should you even buy a console for it, or simply wait for the inevitable PC release instead ? Look, there's no doubt that the vast majority of players will end up playing GTA 6 on PS5 . Sony's console has a sizeable lead over Xbox Series X|S, with around 95 million PS5 consoles sold , compared with an estimated 35 million Xbox Series X|S consoles . But it's not quite as simple as saying, "play it on PS5, like everyone else." For starters, plenty of people still haven't made the jump to the current generation. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, GTA 6 could well be the game that finally convinces you to upgrade. Unfortunately, you couldn't have picked a much more expensive time to do it, with console prices, games, storage, and just about everything else seemingly getting pricier by the minute. It's a sign of the times, I'm afraid. Then there's the question of performance. Rockstar's latest open-world adventure is an enormously ambitious game, and the standard PS5 and Xbox Series X|S have their work cut out for them. The PS5 Pro, meanwhile, has considerably more horsepower than the standard PS5, along with PSSR upscaling, making it an interesting option for anyone looking to get the best possible experience. The PS5 Pro is certainly the console I'd be looking at if money were no object. It has a more powerful GPU than the standard PS5, improved ray tracing capabilities, and Sony's PSSR upscaling technology, all of which should help it get more out of demanding games. That doesn't automatically make it a worthwhile upgrade, though. I'd be wary of spending hundreds of dollars extra on a PS5 Pro purely for the promise of better performance in GTA 6 . There's a difference between getting a sharper image or more consistent performance and suddenly unlocking a completely different experience. Whether those improvements justify the considerable price premium is another matter entirely. That being said, if you forced me to give an answer, the PS5 Pro is still probably the best option for getting the most out of GTA 6 on console. If only it wasn't so horrendously expensive, and so difficult to find at a reasonable price right now. If you don't already own a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S , GTA 6 presents a slightly awkward conundrum. On the one hand, this is arguably the biggest game release of the generation ( and probably of all time, quite honestly ), and you're probably going to want to play it ASAP. On the other, buying an entire console for one game is an increasingly expensive proposition in 2026. Sony's current US prices put the PS5 Digital Edition at $599.99 , the standard PS5 with a disc drive at $649.99 , and the PS5 Pro at a frankly eye-watering $899.99 . Microsoft isn't doing much better, with the Xbox Series S now costing $499.99 and the Xbox Series X reaching $749.99 for the digital model or $799.99 with a disc drive. Yikes. Yet, somehow, despite these bonkers prices, there's somehow also an argument for buying sooner rather than later. Console prices have been consistently heading in the wrong direction, and the broader component shortage isn't exactly helping. Major retailers have already warned that console stock could struggle to keep up with demand over the holiday period, with one senior games buyer claiming retailers have been told they won't receive the number of consoles they want ahead of GTA 6's launch. That's not exactly a guarantee that you'll be fighting scalpers for a PS5 come November, though. Sony insists it has secured enough memory to hit its PS5 sales target for the financial year, despite the ongoing component difficulties. Yet, with GTA 6 expected to drive a huge upgrade cycle, I'd rather have my console sorted well before November 19 than find myself scrambling for one at the last minute. Still, if you can, I would still avoid rushing out and paying full price for a console simply because GTA 6 is coming. If you're starting from scratch, keep an eye out for bundles, retailer promotions, trade-in offers, and, particularly as we get closer to November, any GTA 6-specific console deals that might appear. Honestly, refurbished is where I'd be looking right now if you're trying to keep the cost of getting GTA 6-ready as low as possible. You're not going to get much of a discount on brand-new PS5 hardware at the moment, so a reputable refurbished model can make considerably more sense. That's why the next deal I'd consider is a certified refurbished PS5 directly from PlayStation through the PS Direct store . A refurbished PS5 is currently $549, while the refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is $499. If you're happy with digital games, the $499 refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is arguably the most compelling option of the lot, particularly if GTA 6 is the main reason you're buying a console in the first place . ICYMI: Sony has also announced plans to stop producing physical game discs for new PlayStation releases from January 2028, meaning we're potentially looking at the final few years of physical PlayStation gaming. That doesn't mean your existing discs suddenly become useless, or that physical games are disappearing overnight, but it does make the $50 saving on a Digital Edition a little more tempting if you're starting from scratch and don't have an existing physical library. sources.text: Choosing whether to sell to Donnie or Brian isn't just about who pays more After the Clean Up After Donnie GTA 6 mission , Donnie becomes a fence you can sell narcotics, marked notes, and jewelry to, all you have to do is drop them in the deposit box at his trailer in Key Lento. sources.text: Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 retail sales reached $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, securing its place as the biggest entertainment launch of all time. Parent company Take-Two Interactive announced the news today. Rockstar founder and president Sam Houser shared his feelings about the landmark achievement in a statement. "It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI," he said. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you." After quickly emerging as the highest-rated video game of all time , breaking records across streaming sites , and causing wild spikes in internet traffic , we all kind of knew this was coming. After 13 years, Rockstar has pulled off the greatest score anyone has ever seen. Even in this new update, Take-Two said it was "proud" to help GTA 6 adopt its new crown. Earning $3.79 billion in 24 hours is unheard of across any medium, meaning Rockstar's new Grand Theft Auto game didn't just stomp on launch sales for games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Cyberpunk 2077, or any Call of Duty game; it crushed any blockbuster movie release ever, too. It's still got a ways to go before claiming any titles like 'best all-time sales,' but it's a start better than anyone has ever seen in the history of gaming. Just yesterday, it was reported that GTA 6 had managed to sell more than 20 million pre-order copies . Courtesy of Take-Two today, we now know that, somehow, these already staggering numbers actually significantly undershot the reality. The company has now confirmed that it actually moved 32.5 million pre-sale units alone. That's more copies than the vast majority of games have ever sold. Some very rough napkin math led to estimates that Take-Two Interactive expected to make as much as $3.5 billion during the Grand Theft Auto 6 launch period. It actually made more than that on the GTA 6 launch day: Rockstar says the game pulled in $3.79 billion in "day one retail sales," making it "the biggest entertainment launch in history." By way of comparison, Avengers: Endgame, ranked on Wikipedia as the highest grossing movie of all time, earned a little more than $2.9 billion over its entire theatrical run. GTA 6 crushed that by nearly $1 billion in a day . "It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto 6," Rockstar Games president and co-founder Sam Houser said. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you." Strauss Zelnick, CEO of publisher Take-Two Interactive, had previously said that preorder levels of Grand Theft Auto 6 were "unprecedented" but declined to reveal specifics . It turns out he wasn't kidding: Take-Two Interactive also revealed today that GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies in pre-release, which it said is "a new record across all platforms." Those numbers are absolutely staggering: There was never any question that GTA 6 was going to be huge, but those launch days sales—sales from one single day —surpass Take Two's net revenue guidance for the entire quarter by nearly $400 million at the high end. Given that there's still well over a month remaining in the holiday season, I'd expect that figure to rise significantly: I'm not an industry analyst but more than $4 billion before the year is over suddenly seems just about conservative. Beyond that, I won't even hazard a guess, but consider this: Grand Theft Auto 5 , which sold a little over 11 million copies on its launch day in 2013, has now surpassed 230 million copies sold in total. The sky, to paraphrase one of Tom Petty's other songs, really is the limit. sources.title: GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, selling 32.5 million pre-sale copies and a bonkers $3.79 billion in its first day
sources.text: "We are incredibly humbled by the response." Surprise, surprise - GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing its predecessor's 13-year-long record and the already optimistic analyst estimates. Rockstar Games today confirmed that its cultural juggernaut sold a staggering 32.5 million pre-release copies across PS5 and Xbox Series X/S before its official worldwide launch on the 19th of November. By the end of its first day on sale, GTA 6 managed to rake in a frankly absurd $3.79bn. Not a bad haul. As Rockstar was quick to brag, the whopping performance means GTA 6 set "a new record for entertainment across any medium" by "becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history." For context, GTA 5 made around $800m in its opening 24 hours more than a decade ago. That mammoth debut almost looks quaint next to GTA 6's stunning numbers, although it's notable GTA 5 didn't launch immediately in Japan or Brazil - GTA 6 is available in almost every market with access to PlayStation and Xbox consoles. "It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI," said Rockstar co-founder and company president, Sam Houser, in a recent press release. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn't be more excited to share this moment with you." Previous estimates guessed that GTA 6 had sold almost 25m copies ($2.5bn in revenue) on day one. It's fair to say the game's staggering performance blew even those sky-high projections out of the water. Every early indicator pointed to GTA 6's inevitably record-breaking launch. Parent company Take-Two previously said the game was tracking "well above expectations," as the crime fest sold more pre-orders than any other game in PlayStation Store and Xbox Store history . The only question now is whether GTA 6 can ever outsell GTA 5's mammoth 230m copies, which it reached thanks to a very healthy cadence of GTA Online updates. How high GTA 6 can go will likely depend on its multiplayer offering, though Rockstar hasn't said anything concrete about that just yet. "A game of opposites and awe, minute detail and impossible scale, Rockstar pushes back the horizon of video games once again with GTA 6. An irreducible mix of silliness, intimacy, grand ideas and rock 'n' roll action - and a load more after that," Chris Tapsell gushed in Eurogamer's GTA 6 review .

sources.title: How to Get Ready for November 19
sources.text: November 19, 2026, has long been circled on your calendar. Birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays have come and gone, but this day belongs to you and your XBOX console. We can hardly believe it’s almost here, either. Once midnight strikes, you want to be locked in the action, so to help you prepare, we created a checklist to ensure distractions are put to bed so you can settle in for a season of gaming like nothing you’ve ever experienced before. 2026 has been full of some absolute bangers: Gears of War E-Day, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Forza Horizon 6, Halo: Campaign Evolved, Minecraft Dungeons II, Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred , Control Resonant , Mixtape , Pragmata , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Star Wars: Galactic Racer , 007 First Light , Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve … seriously, all these games came out this year . That also means you might have a hard drive that is nearing capacity. And you will be faced with some hard choices to free up approximately 212GB of space on your XBOX Series X|S before November 19. You could always upgrade the capacity of your console to keep all your games at the ready, using the storage expansion slot on the back of the console. Otherwise, you’ll have a hard choice to make which we do not envy. But know that you’re in good company – we had to find a way to make room too. XBOX Cloud Gaming means that you don’t need to own an XBOX Series X|S console to experience the latest games (or use up that hard drive space) – you can stream directly from the cloud to your XBOX One console. Game Pass subscribers receive an allotment of hours per month as part of their plans, but you can also purchase blocks of time . Certain upcoming major releases have been confirmed as cloud-ready on day one , so even if you don’t own a current gen console, your latest obsession isn’t out of reach. You never want to settle in for a long gaming session only to immediately get hit with an update download. If you haven’t used your XBOX Series X|S or XBOX One in a minute, be sure to power up and connect to the internet beforehand and make sure you’re all set with the latest system updates. You can also install any upcoming releases you may have pre-ordered, while you’re at it. If you’re feeling a gaming flu coming on (and there’s a lot of that going around right now), then take a sick day, rather than risk infecting your coworkers or classmates. Sometimes you just need to listen to your body’s needs, relax, and let the fever run its course. Miami’s own DJ Khaled, aka Dr. XBOX will write you a personalized note to help explain the situation. If this thing is really serious, you may even need the whole week to recover – it’s the responsible thing to do. We all have responsibilities. Some of them come with four legs and a suspect bladder. Don’t let Rufus ruin your gaming fun. Get ahold of a local dog walker to take them outside so you can enjoy the big day uninterrupted. Or drop them off at doggie daycare for a day (or week) to get them out of your hair. Is your XBOX in an area of the house that is easily accessible to younger players? Consider the steps you need to take to get it out of younger sightlines, like running an extension cable out to the shed in the backyard or huddling up in your at-home office. Even if you do find yourself bouncing between rooms, your save files reside in the Cloud, allowing you to pick up your session wherever you last plugged your console in. We’re always on the hunt for new tunes and one of the things we’re most looking forward to on November 19 is discovering a whole bunch of new tracks that are sure to make our listening playlist pop throughout the year. You can get started here on Spotify . XBOX Design Lab lets you create your own next-gen XBOX Wireless Controller. Choose from a combination of colors, patterns, textured grips, and more. You could even pick up some specially themed versions of controllers styled in hot pink and pastels – this one is particularly striking . Speaking of controllers, if you expect long gaming sessions in your near future, make sure that it’s plugged in so it has a full charge when you need it, or stock up on AA batteries. Maybe even get a backup controller ready so you can hot-swap them in and minimize interruptions. Looking for something to add to your queue? Check out the 1967 classic, “Bonnie and Clyde,” featuring Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway to get you in the mood for an epic story about two tragic lovers who fall into a life of crime. We’ll have to wait and see if the outcome is any different this time around starting on November 19.

sources.text: Get your hands on the classic bright green Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6 Finding, buying, and stealing your dream car or bike is a peak part of Grand Theft Auto, and mine is the Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6, based on the bright green car driven by Paul Walker as Brian O'Conner in the original movie. To find Paul Walker's Fast and Furious Mitsubishi in GTA 6, you need to head towards Vice Beach, to the east of Vice City. The car is locked in a garage on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands to the west of Vice Beach. You can see the exact location marked on the map above. You'll have to break into the garage and steal the car, which is actually a lot easier than it sounds, but I've got more details on that below. As you'd expect, the Mitsubishi handles really well and hits high speeds, so it's one of the best GTA 6 cars you can get your hands on, especially in the early game, for free, and without picking up too much heat. To steal Paul Walker's GTA 6 car, head to the garage and break in. This triggers an alarm, but you can switch that off pretty quickly on the wall to your left as you head in. Open the garage door here too, break into the car, hotwire it, and drive away - simple as that. There are a few additional details to note here, though, that make this experience easier or better for you overall. sources.title: How To Get A Bank Account in GTA 6
sources.text: Most of us take a bank account for granted in real life, but GTA 6 requires you to get one for Jason and Lucia. A fundamental basic for grown-ups, Jason and Lucia’s lives have made getting one difficult, but not impossible. I approached an ATM in GTA 6 ‘s early hours as Jason, and a notification popped up saying I needed a bank account. Not only that, but lots of weapons and items are locked out until you get a bank account—so let’s get one! You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! You get a bank account during Chapter 1, once Lucia is out of prison and reunited with Jason, and she asks Jason if they can get a bank account. In Chapter 1, the time comes for Jason to bring Lucia home. You have an evening at a bar with friends; there’s a fist fight outside, and Jason and Lucia (presumably) get quite naked with each other. However, shortly after you’re reunited, you’ll get a phone call from Lucia, asking about a bank account, and Jason replies that he hasn’t got one. As you know, Jason has a stash at his house which acts as a bank account. A main story mission sees you go to Fleeca Bank to get a bank account, and despite the bank being unable to give you a proper account, you will gain a wonderfully named BuckMe account, which you can use as an app on your phone, and it lets you finally use ATMs. BuckMe lets you deposit and withdraw money and essentially replaces the more cumbersome stash system in GTA 6. There’s a kiddish charm about having money under a floorboard, but it’s not practical for a grown adult who needs to keep thousands of dollars secure. BuckMe acts like a normal banking app, and you can also use it to increase your savings account, required to progress through the main story, as Jason and Lucia create a savings account to earn money for their child. sources.title: How to get a GTA 6 jet easily and cause chaos in the skies
sources.text: You can fly a GTA 6 jet right at the start of the game by raiding the nearby military base, and here's how to do it Knowing how to get a jet in GTA 6 is essential information if you're planning to cause chaos, as taking control of one of these military aircraft is considered peak criminal behavior. While you'd expect that significant progress in GTA 6 would be required before you even had a chance of swiping such high-end hardware, you can actually go and help yourself to one pretty much as soon as you start the game. To try it yourself, here's how to steal a jet in GTA 6. The location for a number of GTA 6 jets is the Mile Zero Air Station, which is found by heading west along the main road from the starting area, through Abismo Key, then on to Southwind and the miliary base itself. You can drive there in any vehicle, though I recommend not using your GTA 6 personal vehicle as it will get trashed and left inside the base, so steal a sturdy and reasonably fast vehicle for the job. Purchasing and equipping body armor from Ammu-nation will also improve your odds of surviving the initial stage. Follow the route marked on my map above, which will lead you through some barriers on the road to a set of soldiers who will open fire, then take the first turning right and drive through more soldiers until you see a dirt pile ahead that you can hit to clear the security fences. This is also a Stunt Jump, though you don't need to complete it as long as you clear the perimeter and land on the runway. Once on the runway inside the miliary base, drive straight ahead to where you'll see several GTA 6 jets parked up next to hangars. Pull up alongside one, jump out of your car and hop straight into the cockpit, before firing up the afterburner and turning onto the runway to take off. Once you've taken control of your jet and got airborne, follow the prompt to retract the landing gear and you're away! Be aware that you'll have attracted at least a five-star GTA 6 Wanted Level with this theft, which could go up to six if you start blowing things up, so multiple military jets will be scrambled to shoot you down with homing missiles. I was barely able to reach the first bridge before getting blown out of the sky, but if you fly low and take evasive action you may fare better – good luck! If you're looking for an impressive ride that's easier to obtain then here's how to steal the GTA 6 Paul Walker car , which you can then use to arrive in style at the various GTA 6 Strip Club locations around Leonida. sources.text: The leaked file is apparently around 200 GB. Mysterious GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has reemerged in the wake of GTA 6's release with another leak: This time, they have released what they claim to be a near-complete build of GTA 6 on Xbox from November 2026. In their post, Cyberleek says they'll drop the one file they've withheld—the main executable—if their crypto coin reaches a $15 million market cap. Yeah, we're doing this again. Comments on a now-removed Reddit post say the leaked file is around 200 GB, which is close to the size of GTA 6 on consoles. Cyberleek says they will release the exe on November 23, no matter what. "It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons," the posts read. "If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, CL will work to get a PS5 build—a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two/Rockstar." Last we heard from Cyberleek was over a month ago, when they were threatening Take-Two with a " dead man's switch ", which many took to mean they'd either post major story spoilers or leak the game in its entirety. We've yet to see confirmation that the build is genuine, but that could come as soon as tonight. If it is, it'll be anywhere between a few days or hours before the executable comes: According to Cyberleek's site, their crypto currently sits at a $1.83 million cap.
